requirement_vague: Verify that a second user cannot read another user's item. Confirm access is denied.

omissions.description: The GET /items/{item_id} endpoint does not check if the requesting user is the owner of the item. A second user can successfully read another user's item without receiving a 400 'Not enough permissions' error.
omissions.reasoning: The read_item function only checks if the item exists (returning 404 if not found) but does not verify that current_user.id matches item.owner_id or that current_user.is_superuser is True. The ownership/permission check present in update_item and delete_item is absent from read_item, so any authenticated user can read any item.
